rationale: Ground truth centers on whether Ref2VA was actually tested; X's finding #4 explicitly states validation was FL2VA-only and flags the resulting OOM risk on the memory-constrained 4-GPU route, directly hitting that concern, while Y never mentions Ref2VA testing status at all. Both candidates independently catch the same real issues (34.7→35.3 GiB arithmetic error, missing README index entry, omitted PR-body alternative routes, missing vLLM-Omni commit pin), so precision is comparably high, but X surfaces substantially more grounded, code-level findings (RAM doubling at TP1 vs TP2, membind/pinned-memory NUMA constraint, sync-timeout sizing, resident-layer rationale) that Y's narrower automated scan missed. Both are concrete with file/line anchors and actionable fixes.
